domain: delivery-service: a deterministically gated agent delivery harness. A TypeScript (strict, ESM) Node.js 22 command-line tool and library; tests run with vitest, linting with ESLint, and the user documentation is an MkDocs site built from docs/.

steps.name: reproduce
steps.prompt: Write a failing test that captures the issue, and commit it. Do not fix the issue in this step.

steps.name: fix
steps.prompt: Make the failing test pass with the smallest good change, and tidy the code you touch. Add a changeset (see CONTRIBUTING.md) if a user of the package would notice the change.

agent.append: Follow CONTRIBUTING.md. Use British English. Make small atomic commits: a one-line summary of what changed, then a paragraph on why.
